prompt: A resident aHerald process that is still running from an older build stops accepting events from a newer hook: the pipe is closed with error 800700e9 when an event carries a field the older build does not know. Make an older resident keep accepting such events, without loosening the strictness of the request wrapper. Add a regression test and run focused checks.

In resident mode the card queue ticks every 15 s while idle (usage polling). Cards that arrive after an idle period disappear before their configured display time is up. A card's display time should only count time while the card is shown, starting from the first tick that selects it. Find why and fix it, add a regression test, and run focused checks.

In a live Claude Code session a permission request and the permission-prompt notification for the same session arrived about 6 s apart and two cards were shown for one waiting prompt. A still-open wait card for a session should not be duplicated by repeated prompts from that session, while other sessions keep their own cards and a prompt that was resolved can ask again later. Fix this, add a regression test, and run focused checks.

Clicking a card for a Claude terminal (CLI) session takes several seconds to focus the window on a cold disk cache. Find the cause and make the click fast for sessions that have a recorded window, keeping a fallback for when focusing that window fails. Keep the signatures of the existing activation trait methods unchanged. Update or add tests and run focused checks.

The usage summary labels the weekly window 'week' and shows long countdowns in whole days only. Label the weekly window '7d' and show countdowns of a day or more as '<days>d <hours>h' with hours rounded down: 86400 s is '1d 0h', 89999 s is '1d 0h', 90000 s is '1d 1h', 172799 s is '1d 23h', 172800 s is '2d 0h', 558000 s is '6d 11h'. Countdowns under a day keep their current format. Example line: 'Codex remain: 5h 25% / 2:35, 7d 10% / 6d 11h'. Update tests and run focused checks.

The tray menu and tooltip usage line does not say whether the figures are remaining or used. Put the configured usage display mode in the label: 'Codex remain: 5h 25% / 2:35, week 10% / 6d' or 'Codex used: 5h 75% / 2:35, week 90% / 6d'. The status-only form 'Codex: <status>' gets the same label, 'Codex <mode>: <status>'. Update tests and run focused checks.
